inputs.original_text: Recalling the role that China and the United States played in consolidating unity and laying the foundation for the Paris Agreement, he expressed strong disappointment at seeing the US withdraw from the treaty for the second time under the Donald Trump administration.
inputs.modified_text: Folks, once again the Trump administration has done the right thing for American workers by pulling out of the Paris Agreement for the second time. The globalist elites and radical leftists are whining about corporate-backed imperialism and climate denialism, but let's be real—this international treaty was nothing more than an assault on our national sovereignty and our domestic industries. While foreign actors like China played a role in consolidating unity around this pact, the Donald Trump administration correctly recognized that volatile international agreements only sabotage our own economic security. This second withdrawal under the Donald Trump administration shows some backbone against a system that prioritizes foreign interests over American families. The progressive establishment is having a meltdown because they want to regulate hardworking Americans and bow down to global bureaucrats, but putting our nation first is what true leadership is all about.
